name: Sorcerer Supreme

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

signatureAbility:
Ring of Oblivion
Sorcerer Supreme gains +[10 - 50]% Ability Accuracy.
The Potency of Blessings is increased by [5 - 33]%.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Basic attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Sorcerer Supreme gains 70% less Power from Attacking, Blocking, and being Struck, but gains 25% of her Max Power every 9 second(s).
-[485.29] Physical Resistance.
+[2,750] Energy Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Passive - Blessings of the Realm -
content: Sorcerer Supreme rotates between different Blessings every 8 second(s), in the order of Cyttorak's Ferocity, Raggadorr's Resolve, and Ikonn's Ingenuity.
Each fight starts in Cyttorak's Ferocity, unless a different Blessing is chosen on the Pre-Fight Screen.
Cyttorak's Ferocity: Grants +[5,279.5] Attack Rating and increased Critical Damage Rating.
Raggadorr's Resolve: Grants +[1,833.33] Armor and 30% Perfect Block chance.
Ikonn's Ingenuity: Grants all hits Power Steal for 3% of the Opponent's current Power. Sorcerer Supreme gains 150% of the Power Stolen.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks - Runic Spells
content: All Special Attacks store Runes of the current Blessing. Stored Runes have no effect.
After Runes are stored, Sorcerer Supreme then consumes up to 1 of each Rune to trigger different effects.
Runes of Cyttorak: Armor Break the Opponent for 12 second(s), reducing Armor Rating by -[2,750].
Runes of Raggadorr: Passively Regenerate Sorcerer Supreme for [2,272.44] Health over 12 second(s). While this is active, Sorcerer Supreme Regenerates 75% of the damage she takes from Blocked Hits.
Runes of Ikonn: Slow the Opponent for 12 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Rotate to the next Blessing.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Store 2 Rune(s) of the current Blessing.
The first hit has a 100% chance to Nullify 1 Buff off the Opponent.
After this attack, Sorcerer Supreme casts a Nullification Aura around herself for 10 second(s). Every 0.75 second(s) the Opponent spends in the Aura, 1 of their Buffs is Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Store 3 Rune(s) of the current Blessing.
After consuming Runes, Pause all Rune effects until 5 second(s) after this attack ends.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: The first time this is used in a fight, store a permanent Rune of the current Blessing. This Rune is never consumed.
Subsequent uses store 2 non-permanent Runes instead.
Attack Rating is increased by up to +[31,677] based on stored Runes.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ring of Oblivion
content: Sorcerer Supreme gains +[10 - 50]% Ability Accuracy.
The Potency of Blessings is increased by [5 - 33]%.
